### PPP_ZDGNSS.PCF

 PRECISE POINT POSITIONING (PPP) - extended version As the basic version this PPP-BPE - computes coordinates, troposphere and receiver clocks - updates the coordinate/velocity files It may also compute - geocenter coordinates from all datum stations included in the PPP procedure, - pseudo-kinematic coordinates, - high-rate troposphere (15 minutes sampling), and These additional features may be enabled (or disabled) by specifying a non-blank/blank solution identifier for the corresponding PCF variable. Furthermore this BPE demonstrates both opportunities to pre-process the phase data for zero-difference processing: - RNXSMT: consistency check with the code measurements based on Melburne-Wuebbena linear combination (requires dual frequency data) - MAUPRP: a sophisticated interpretation of epoch-difference residuals based on PPP (requires precise satellite clock correction with the same sampling as the data are)

- Author: R. Dach
- Created: 01-Aug-2020
- Source: [PPP_ZDGNSS.PCF](../../GPSUSER/PCF/GRAVEYARD/PPP_ZDGNSS.PCF)

### CLEANUP

- Purpose: Clean up campaign of LEOPOD processing: - Append first 100 lines of GNSS PRE file and clock RINEX file, as well as ERP file to PRC file - Delete GNSS clock RINEX file - Delete LEO RINEX file and smoothed LEO RINEX file - Delete LEO attitude file - Delete OUT/$A$YSS+0.CLK (CODSPP of PID 110) - Delete OUT/M$A?$YSS+0.RES (MAUPRP of PID 140) - Delete OUT/$A$YSS+0.RES (GPSEST of PID 150) - Compress OUT/KN$F$YSS+0.COV (GPSEST of PID 600) - Compress OUT/KN$F$YSS+0.CLK (GPSEST of PID 600) The Bernese clock file and the GNSS orbit and ERP files are not deleted since they might still be used if several LEOs are processed in parallel.
- Used in PCFs: LEOPODR.PCF
- Read keys:
  - V_ variables: `V_A`, `V_ATT`, `V_B`, `V_CLEAN`, `V_CLK`, `V_DEL`, `V_F`, `V_LEO`
  - PARAM parameters: `PARAM1`
  - Other keys: `$S+0`, `$W+0`, `$WD+0`, `$Y`, `$YSS+0`, `DIR_ATT`, `DIR_CLK`, `DIR_CZH`, `DIR_CZO`, `DIR_EDT`, `DIR_ELE`, `DIR_ERP`, `DIR_IEP`, `DIR_KIN`, `DIR_LST`, `DIR_OUT`, `DIR_PLT`, `DIR_PRE`, `DIR_PZH`, `DIR_PZO`

- File patterns: `$_[0]`
- Source: [CLEANUP](../../GPSUSER/SCRIPT/CLEANUP)

### DEL_RES_PPP_s_new

- Package: `DEL_RES_PPP`
- Purpose: Clean up campaign of PPP processing, default for -5 sessions
- Used in PCFs: ZDGNSS_PPP_new.PCF
- Read keys:
  - V_ variables: `V_APR`, `V_DEL`, `V_FIN`, `V_GCC`, `V_HOIFIL`, `V_KIN`, `V_ORB`, `V_OSBFIL`, `V_PPP`, `V_RED`, `V_REF`, `V_TRP`
  - PARAM parameters: `PARAM1`
  - Other keys: ` ) {
        prtMess($bpe,`, ` ) {
      $param1 = `, ` . $param1 unless $param1 =~ /^[\-+]/;
      ($yyyyssss, $ssss, $yyyyddd) =
      $bpe->getKeys('$YYYSS'.$param1, '$S'.$param1, '$YYYD'.$param1)
    }

# Delete BSW model files with the same scheme as the other files
    if ( $thisSess ne $yyyyssss ) {
      $hoiFil =~ s/_$thisSess/_$yyyyssss/;
      $osbFil =~ s/_$thisSess/_$yyyyssss/;
    }

# Delete Files if requested

### OBS_SAV

- Purpose: Store observation files from a campaign into an archive Remark  :  The value of the PCF variable V_SAVOBS must be Y to start saving the observation files: baseline phase files (if available) otherwise zero-difference code and/or phase files (according to the value of the PCF variable V_OBSTYP). Alternatively behind the "Y" a list of extensions may be added to overlay the default behaviour, e.g., "Y PZH CZH" to force saving all available zero-difference phase and code observation files. Note: all files in the session's archive directory are removed.
- Used in PCFs: PPP_ZDGNSS.PCF
- Read keys:
  - V_ variables: `V_LEO`, `V_OBSTYP`, `V_RESULT`, `V_SAVOBS`

- File patterns: `"V_RESULT/OBS/$YYYSS+0//????$S+0.$extHed"`, `"V_RESULT/OBS/$YYYSS+0//????$S+0.unknown"`, `DIR_PSH/????$S+0.EXT_PSH`, `DIR_PZH/$pattern$S+0.EXT_PZH`, `DIR_CZH/$pattern$S+0.EXT_CZH`, `V_RESULT/OBS/$YYYSS+0//????$S+0.EXT_PZH`, `V_RESULT/OBS/$YYYSS+0//????$S+0.EXT_PZO`, `V_RESULT/OBS/$YYYSS+0//????$S+0.EXT_CZH`, `V_RESULT/OBS/$YYYSS+0//????$S+0.EXT_CZO`, `DIR_CLB$YYYSS+0[0-9][0-9].EXT_CLB`, `V_RESULT/OBS/$YYYSS+0//????$S+0.EXT_PSH`, `V_RESULT/OBS/$YYYSS+0//????$S+0.EXT_PSO` and 4 more

### PPP_RES_SUM_s_new

- Package: `PPP_RES_SUM`
- Purpose: Check zero- or double-difference data screening results and creates a summary on the residual screening: 1. RESRMS to create F(irst) residual screening summary 2. RESRMS to create L(ast) residual screening summary 3. RESCHK to create residual screening statistics Binary data files of misbehaving stations are subsequently removed if indicated After deleting stations the BPE processing is continued with SNGDIF in case of double-difference processing.

### RES_SUM

- Purpose: Check zero- or double-difference data screening results and creates a summary on the residual screening: 1. RESRMS to create F(irst) residual screening summary 2. RESRMS to create L(ast) residual screening summary 3. RESCHK to create residual screening statistics Binary data files of misbehaving stations are subsequently removed if indicated After deleting stations the BPE processing is continued with SNGDIF in case of double-difference processing.
- Bernese programs: `RESCHK`, `RESRMS`

- File deletes: `DIR_SUMRES_$YYYSS+0.EXT_SUM`, `DIR_OUTRES_$YYYSS+0.PRC if STARTCOUNT == 1`
- Source: [RES_SUM](../../GPSUSER/SCRIPT/GRAVEYARD/RES_SUM)

### ZD_PPP_RES_SUM

- Package: `PPP_RES_SUM`
- Purpose: Check zero- or double-difference data screening results and creates a summary on the residual screening: 1. RESRMS to create F(irst) residual screening summary 2. RESRMS to create L(ast) residual screening summary 3. RESCHK to create residual screening statistics Binary data files of misbehaving stations are subsequently removed if indicated After deleting stations the BPE processing is continued with SNGDIF in case of double-difference processing.

- File deletes: `DIR_SUMRES_$YYYSS+0.EXT_SUM`, `DIR_OUTRES_$YYYSS+0.PRC if STARTCOUNT == 1`
- Source: [ZD_PPP_RES_SUM](../../GPSUSER/SCRIPT/ZD_PPP_RES_SUM)
